slug.description: Active game slug. Injected by the workbench host; required.

assetPath.description: Game-relative path of a RIGGED asset (from gen3d:auto-rig). The animated GLB+FBX for this motion are appended to THIS asset. Dispatch is by the asset's recorded rig system (Meshy public default, Hunyuan dev fallback).

actionId.description: Meshy path (public-beta default): a positive action_id chosen from gen3d:list-motions. Drives Meshy /animations via the asset's OWN rig_task_id. Idempotent per motion; required when the asset was Meshy-rigged.

label.description: Optional display label for the chosen motion (the UI passes the action name it showed). Stored on the clip; the catalog is not re-queried. Defaults to "动作 <id>".

autoReRig.description: Meshy only: when the rig task has expired (~3 days), re-rig first (+credits) instead of failing with rig_expired. Default false.

motionType.description: Hunyuan dev path only: v1 fixed motion 9 跨步 / 10 摔倒 / 11 跳跃 / 12 踢腿 / 13 挥击 / 14 步行 / 15 跑步 / 16 跳舞. Used (and required) when the asset was rigged via Hunyuan. Idempotent per motion.
